predicate.statement: The following Product identities are distinct and exhaustive at the architecture boundary; do not merge them because they cooperate.
The released Product packages GTL, validator, HoG, ABG, catalog/Public contracts, standard library, SDK/CLI, Product management, conformance, proof and release assets.

Every callable has GTL structure. Implementation bindings may realize admitted leaf seams, not replace template/graph/published contract. Calls from GTL or Public require membership in the selected admitted Program and catalog view. Purpose informs selection but grants neither applicability, effect authority nor proof of achieved outcome.

HoG may not author/lower/select/publish a rival Program. Pure case-specific route, retry, workflow, recursion, fan-out, consensus or continuation coordinators are not irreducible merely because pure; wrapping an imperative coordinator in Effect does not meet this evaluator. Invocation-local frame/cursor/queue/binding/cache state stays subordinate, cannot alter Program meaning or be published/resumed independently.

Every executable boundary declares one regime. Open-world judgment, semantic inference and hidden defaults are not F_D, which is not a quality label. F_P cannot emit ABG truth, choose continuation or certify closure. F_H crosses typed admission and cannot override deterministic invalidity or directly write runtime truth; a proxy actor does not become underlying authority.

Child traversal has its own graph-call/frame/basis/entry/associatedRun/parent/foldback, without automatically creating a new user task, intent or workspace authority. Changed authority follows binding/re-entry preserving predecessor identity/cause. First(B,x0) admits x1; second(B,x1) consumes that producer output through declared transfer/transformation. Authenticate current traversal input and its causal producer, not unchanged graph entry; byte equality alone proves neither producer identity nor permission. Nested calls keep declared entry/foldback without turning every sequential handoff into a child call.

Preparation binds current input/contracts/permitted effects. HoG traverses; declared owner performs effects; ABG admits results/evidence and owns continuation. Distinct regimes persist; refusal/failure/hold/unresolved follow declared routes and probabilistic/human replies remain candidates until admitted. Execution failure does not imply unchanged workspace: performed effects/observations remain attributable even when admission/later work fails. Missing post-effect observation withdraws dependent currentness only over potentially affected scope, preserves unaffected facts and records unknown state; no fabricated rollback/successor observation.

predicate.statement: Closed deterministic policy/state rules may be F_D; applicability, prioritization and sufficiency remain judgment without a total declared rule. Plugin realizes only its seam. Results identify frame, evaluated subject, observation basis, applicable criteria, evidence, residuals and permitted proposal. Missing evidence/unknown applicability/insufficient frame/invalid basis preserves unresolved/refusal and cannot suppress required evaluation or establish satisfaction. Weights/thresholds prioritize permitted choices but cannot average away mandatory constraints, independence or owner rulings. Applicability and graph selection are declared computations; interpreter follows admitted selections without inventing policy or necessity from catalog presence.

Selection produces exact registered function/purpose/inputs/supporting reason or gap; admission accepts or refuses; advancement follows admitted choice. Purpose/catalog presence alone grants no applicability/permission. F_P judges suitability absent total rule. Missing graph or unresolved support preserves gap, never authorizes graph generation. Changed evidence may revise choice or justify applicable admitted result reuse, without rewriting Program or extending callable/catalogue scope. Template materialization/recursion remain ordinary execution; runtime authoring/publication/recomposition of new graph definitions is excluded.

Auditor may evaluate policies/intervals covered by admitted projection; current-workspace claims additionally need applicable observations. Broader Executive/strategic frames grant neither global context nor authority. Investigations are ordinary child graphs with declared conjunction/foldback, preserving required independence, unaffected valid work and unresolved parent obligations; child success does not complete parent. Under the same bound observations and admitted evaluator outputs preserve permitted choices/effects/refusals/completion conditions. Changed frame/observation basis invalidates dependent evaluations only; this conditional conservation does not require identical stochastic answers or mandatory whole-history/workspace scans.

This scoped external owner/operator publication is not a native qualified snapshot; Q22 sequencing does not block it, but fifteen-family destination, qualified S07 native path and final promises remain. Exact source/artifact/install/readback are preserved; historical Hello/qualification cannot transfer to a different package digest. Only accepted changes actually executed through ABG count as accepted output; failures/workarounds/retries/interventions remain visible, missing cost telemetry unknown, and tiny success is not productivity proof.

F12/S04 observer/tuner Product/public surfaces remain distinct and reserved, without prohibiting selected ordinary graph governance or removing its proof obligations. No new family is created. 5.0 selection is limited to preregistered graphs; dynamic generation/recomposition/runtime publication is excluded. Future graph construction is ordinary recursive work over GTL primitives whose candidates require publication/validation/admission; it supplies no second language/planner/runtime and this Product assigns it no release.

5.0 retains declared child/Executive recursion with same HoG, bounds, admitted foldback and parent re-evaluation, including declared cross-branch scope, without child-success-as-parent-completion. Autonomous upstream/out-of-traversal A.0/coordination is 5.1. Existing continuation/restart/recovery/typed stops remain required but yield_continuation production is 5.1. Progress/timeout/interruption/causal events/replay liveness and bounded governance observations remain runtime truth; dedicated observer/tuner drafts/ratification/public surfaces are F12/S04 in 5.1. Generic composition/recursion/attribution/admission/replay remain 5.0; preserve Consensus code/evidence without dedicated complete claim, with standalone F08/S05 agreement/dispute/multi-workspace campaigns in 5.1. Native SDK/CLI independence, one Public authority and worker transport are required; retained adapters remain truthful thin projections, while extra host-adapter work and mandatory Codex/native parity qualify in 5.1.

Preserve original ambiguity and do not replace the contract with an easier one after execution. Truthful bounded failure/block may complete evaluation: retain assumptions/interpretations, unmet obligations, realized behavior, attempted revisions/depth and actual stop. Evaluation completion is not application completion or automatic obligation to retry. A separately selected complete-app claim still needs all mandatory outcomes. Generic structural/authority/admission/runtime-truth violations remain Product defects even in demanding cases; successful bounded F17/S06 witness remains required.

Selection precedes successor construction and result inspection. Reuse existing work/evidence only within supported original claims; weaker observed results cannot determine oracle. A proper subset must be explicit, never renamed whole original specification. Unresolved selected obligations prevent witness completion. Exclusions remain open downstream and cannot supply missing prerequisites or conceal generic 5.0 defects. Weaker result/test suite does not revise selected contract; retained Data Mapper is reusable subject, not proof either contract complete.

Routine work including Data Mapper uses established specification/constraints/admitted authority without routine human approval. Useful declared steel-thread progression may continue carrying unmet obligations only when they do not invalidate next-step prerequisites/authority/hard constraints. Without lawful bounded continuation, return typed block/handoff. Progress neither satisfies gaps nor fabricates prerequisites nor waives closure. Executive applies Consequence recursively through same functions/HoG/ABG; planned F12 adds separately qualified capabilities. Every Worker/Evaluator/Consequence uses a frame defining context/contract/constraints/permitted proposals/return/escalation, not new frame runtime or transferred authority.

Full-tree visibility is indexed replay projections/exact refs plus bounded child investigation/admitted foldback, not the full tree in every prompt. Observation supplies facts, evaluation judgment, Consequence proposes, ABG admits, HoG executes. Wider visibility grants no mutation/reprice/re-entry/closure authority and owner rulings stay reserved. Automatic current-intent continuation, new-action admission, local recursion/correction and fresh replay remain 5.0. Human-response deferral does not defer complete selected witness, self-conformance or actual human acceptance of the same qualified RC; future runtime response differs from release acceptance.
